title: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 3: Mavazi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the four features of fluent reading: clear sounds, a fitting voice, a speaking pace, and gestures with eye contact.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child listens to two readings and names the missing feature in each.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nini kinachoonyesha kusoma kwa ufasaha?" Kwa nini "Kusoma haraka iwezekanavyo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kasi ifaayo si haraka sana wala polepole sana: msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?" Kwa nini "Kupiga kelele" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sauti ipasavyo inasikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ukifika kwenye koma, ufanye nini?" Kwa nini "Niendelee bila kupumzika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alama za uakifishi zinaonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: koma kidogo, kikomo muda mrefu zaidi.

listen_for: kuangalia kitabu tu bila kuwaangalia wasikilizaji
misconceptions.repair: Msomaji mzuri huwaangalia wasikilizaji na kutumia ishara zifaazo.

checks.question: Taja vipengele viwili vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.

skills.key_step: The child reads a phrase as one breath, lets the marks set the pauses and the voice, and checks the listener understood.

floor.prerequisite: Reads short words with every sound clear.
floor.question: Soma: "Mama anapika."

representations: a recording of the child played back
steps: Ask a listener one question about it.
contexts: reading a story to a younger sibling

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child reads the sentence aloud twice: once as a statement, once as the question.

listen_for: Mama ... alinunua ... sare ... mpya ... ya ... shule ... sokoni.
misconceptions.ask: Ukisoma neno moja moja, msikilizaji anaelewa sentensi?
misconceptions.repair: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.

misconceptions.ask: Wasikilizaji waliweza kuelewa uliposoma haraka hivyo?
misconceptions.repair: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.

listen_for: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
misconceptions.ask: Alama iliyo mwishoni mwa sentensi hii ni ipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.

listen_for: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
misconceptions.repair: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.

misconceptions.ask: Sikiliza tofauti kati ya maneno haya mawili. Yanatofautiana wapi?
misconceptions.repair: Tamka "rangi" kama lilivyoandikwa; "langi" ni neno jingine au si neno.

checks.question: Sentensi "Lo, viatu vyako vinang'aa sana!" inasomwa kwa hisia kwa sababu ya alama ipi?
Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
